ops.value: Houston, July 1969. The moon landing party

ops.old: Hot chicken and leek pot pies. Freezing cold in the Aquarius lifeboat.
ops.new: Hot chicken and leek pot pies under flaky lids, for the long night.

ops.old: Devilled eggs with paprika. Lovell's party watches Armstrong walk on the Moon.
ops.new: Devilled eggs with paprika, passed round as Armstrong walks on the Moon.

ops.old: Lovell isn't used to the champagne.
ops.new: Champagne over a sugar cube and bitters. Jim isn't used to it.

value.note: Strong black coffee from the percolator, kept on all night.
